name: paint-studio-monorepo
description: Paint Studio — agent-friendly animation studio with shared core, CLI, and black/yellow editor

scripts.build: npm run build -w @paint-studio/core && npm run build -w paint-studio && npm run build -w @paint-studio/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @paint-studio/core && npm run lint -w paint-studio && npm run lint -w @paint-studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @paint-studio/core && npm run typecheck -w paint-studio && npm run typecheck -w @paint-studio/web
scripts.examples:render: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && node packages/cli/dist/bin.js render examples/bouncing-ball.paint.json -o examples/out/bouncing-ball.gif && node packages/cli/dist/bin.js render examples/ink-logo-reveal.paint.json -o examples/out/ink-logo-reveal.gif && node packages/cli/dist/bin.js render examples/neon-pulse.paint.json -o examples/out/neon-pulse.gif
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
